notes.title: What is happening?
notes.content:
So, its been a minute, first off, HAPPY 2024!

Now, obviously there is a whale in the room here, what happened?
Well, its a mix of burnout, and life.

Burnout is deadly, and i know it too well. Last time i worked on this game was early December.
Not only this, but a lot is happening in my life right now, that's more important than re-making this game is! Such as, my graduation which is this year, applying to post-secondary, and getting a job.

Many things have taken my time, but mostly burnout effected me.

There is plans to resume this game, but please remember i'm just a single dev.
Im also working on a much more popular game called SCP:Facility, which you can also find on steam.
This game has much more popularity and i've been working on it with a developer team.
My time is very small, and i want to leave time for family and friends.

For now, and until i have more time and motivation, I am pausing development on this game.
I understand if some of you are upset, however please respect the fact that I'm just a single guy, there's no team working on this game, its just me. Other games i have teams for now, I've learnt my mistake of trying solo dev, it is not easy.

This game will be paused for awhile until i can dedicate proper time to it. Which may be awhile.

Im sorry i havent told you all sooner, but I hope you understand. Much love to you all for the support of this game, it being me and my friends firsts (now just me). 

I appreciate everything. 

And to the students within Winnipeg that have taken note of this studio, and that have supported it, researched it, and more, thank you.
Because it means more than you all know. I appreciate it, and I hope you as a student find your way in game development as i did.

I was also interviewed by a student for my game development work, i was also interviewed by my local press. Its been amazing, and i couldn't've have asked for a better community around this studio and game. Thank you ALL so MUCH. 

I cannot thank you all enough, games will continue to be made, but also note, at the same time, my life is being made.

I PROMISE this game will be fully released one day.

- Aiden C. Desjarlais

notes.title: 2.6.1 | New Graphics GUI + NEWS
notes.content:
The update for 2.6.1 has been released. Graphics options can now be separately changed in the main menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43481719/051c0f3d9dbd9f6c2bc1aa4b62aab7b56ff1c474.png[/img]

[h1]Why Did this Take So Long?[/h1]
Let me explain why this took so long,
Saving.

Thats why.

The game has something internally called Saveables. I created Saveables.
Basically they are an easy way to write data to the save file. 
Unfortunately for me I dont know how it works anymore, and i have no clue what does what
Because my genius thought it would be fun to not describe anything within the Core. Which is where Saveables are programmed. The core is a 4000+ line script that is essentially the core of the game. 

I forgot how many things in the game work due to rushed variable names and no comments.\
So saving no longer works. I destroyed it (it may still somewhat work sometimes)

Most of you who have played this game before will now see a "Saving Failures" button in the main menu.
This button will show data in the save file that wasn't loaded. Basically old Saveables that no longer exists in-game (removed feature, etc)

[h1]Whats Next Then?[/h1]

[h3]A whole re-write of all the games scripts.[/h3]
This isn't easy, but with the new game mechanic you all voted on its best if i just re do the programming in the game. It allows me to fix all the bugs and make everything actually readable.

No other changes then a complete re-programming of all the scripts. 
Ill keep you all updated with how this goes in the discord server (https://discord.gg/kqqHPPm2ZY) & here.

Hope you enjoy the update, sorry it took so long.

Aiden

notes.title: July 8th - OFFICIAL EARLY ACCESS RELEASE
notes.content:
Hey fellas! 

It's Aiden, from Togi Studios.

Over the past couple of months I've left people waiting, and for too long.

Let me elaborate.

I am the sole person working on this project currently, as the others don't have the resources to.
So for all this time, since about April, I've been doing everything for this game solo.
We have had some "internal" arguments and we no longer have Benjamin on the team (he will still be credited), so its been max, whos been making the graphics, and me, doing everything else.

So that's why it's taken so long. I also got burnt out for about 2 months, but when I checked the wish lists I realized I cant let you all down, not all 800 wish-listers.

So over the past couple of days I have been testing, debugging, and adding to the game.
So here's the release expectations:
1. Early Access
2. Only ONE night (until later releases)
3. Possible minor/some major bugs
4. Crappy AI, that I had no time to re-script

I've done my best as a single entity could, so please, if you have any feedback give it to us on our discord or steam community, it means more than you know, leave a review, bad or good on release, to let us know a path you'd like the game to take, things you'd like to see, or bugs you'd like to be fixed. It's also good to mention that right now we don't have any set direction for Smogs.

Some people also seem to like the OST for Smogs! And thank you if you do, I worked pretty hard on them!
Upon release all OSTs will be released on our YouTube channel! We will also release the FULL Smog's Theme Song on our YouTube at release, a OST not in-game but that will be used in later trailers!

Again, hardset release is July 8th. I have already submitted the build to steam, so you can trust me this time when I say July 8th.

Sorry to everyone who I have kept waiting this time. And I am especially sorry for the low expectations of early access, but I hope we can work together with our community to bring this game to what we all want it to be.

- Aiden C. Desjarlais, FRGames Management & Founder of Togi Studios

notes.title: An Update From The Developers
notes.content:
[u][b]Good morning/afternoon everyone![/b][/u]

id like to quickly announce that we have changed the game name to
[i][b]Five Nights At Smog's[/b][/i]
We felt it fit the game better.
But fear not, the game is still within the Smog's Poutinerie Franchise!

Continuation,
We at ForReal game studios have been hard at work developing FNASP.

We wanted to update all of our 300+ wish listers (thank you!) that the game is on track to be released in Early Access in Q2, around the end of April going into March. Our planned, but not set Early Access release, is April 27th. There is no promises that we can make this date. 

We as a team at FRGames are working everyday making sure you guys get what you came for.

Thanks to everyone for wish listing this game, it means a lot to us, to go from a school project, to forming a studio, to then releasing a game on steam. all with what was in a month. 


We want to make sure you guys get what you wish listed for, but we just need time, as hard working students, we don't get a lot of it.

But be not afraid, as this game is still, everyday, being worked on behind the scenes.
from voicings, to music, to game mechanics.

And we now have plans to add Subtitles to the game, and closed captions.
We feel all games should have this, and we aren't going to forget about them.

Oh, and huge shout out to Aldo Tinoc for the new Smog's Art!

[i][b]- The FRGames Team[/b][/i]
